import pandas as pd
import hopsworks
from hsfs.feature import Feature

proj = hopsworks.login()
fs = proj.get_feature_store()

train = pd.read_csv("data/training_sample.csv")
serve = pd.read_csv("data/serving_log.csv")
print("train shape", train.shape, "serve shape", serve.shape)

feats = lambda: [
    Feature("entity_id", "string", description="Entity identifier"),
    Feature("f1", "double", description="Feature 1"),
    Feature("f2", "double", description="Feature 2"),
    Feature("f3", "double", description="Feature 3"),
    Feature("f4", "double", description="Feature 4"),
    Feature("f5", "double", description="Feature 5"),
]

train_fg = fs.get_or_create_feature_group(
    name="skew_training", version=1,
    description="Training-path feature matrix",
    primary_key=["entity_id"], features=feats(),
    online_enabled=False, statistics_config=False,
)
train_fg.insert(train, wait=True)
print("training inserted")

serve_fg = fs.get_or_create_feature_group(
    name="skew_serving", version=1,
    description="Serving-path logged feature vectors",
    primary_key=["entity_id"], features=feats(),
    online_enabled=False, statistics_config=False,
)
serve_fg.insert(serve, wait=True)
print("serving inserted")

cd "$PWD" && venv/bin/python -c '
import hopsworks
proj = hopsworks.login()
fs = proj.get_feature_store()
train_fg = fs.get_feature_group("skew_training", version=1)
serve_fg = fs.get_feature_group("skew_serving", version=1)

# Platform-side join on entity_id; serving side prefixed
q = train_fg.select_all().join(serve_fg.select_all(), on=["entity_id"], prefix="srv_")
df = q.read()
print("joined shape", df.shape)
print(df.columns.tolist())

import numpy as np
feats = ["f1","f2","f3","f4","f5"]
print("rows after join:", len(df))
for f in feats:
    a = df[f].astype(float).values
    b = df["srv_"+f].astype(float).values
    diff = np.abs(a-b)
    rel = diff/(np.abs(a)+1e-9)
    print(f"{f}: max_abs_diff={diff.max():.6g} mean_abs_diff={diff.mean():.6g} mean_rel={rel.mean():.6g} corr={np.corrcoef(a,b)[0,1]:.6f}")
' 2>&1 | tail -40

cd "$PWD" && venv/bin/python -c '
import hopsworks, numpy as np
proj = hopsworks.login()
fs = proj.get_feature_store()
train_fg = fs.get_feature_group("skew_training", version=1)
serve_fg = fs.get_feature_group("skew_serving", version=1)
q = train_fg.select_all().join(serve_fg.select_all(), on=["entity_id"], prefix="srv_")
df = q.read()
df = df.dropna(subset=["srv_f1"])
print("matched rows:", len(df))
feats=["f1","f2","f3","f4","f5"]
for f in feats:
    a=df[f].astype(float).values; b=df["srv_"+f].astype(float).values
    diff=np.abs(a-b)
    print(f"{f}: max_abs_diff={diff.max():.6g} mean_abs_diff={diff.mean():.6g} corr={np.corrcoef(a,b)[0,1]:.6f}")
print("--- sample of largest-diverging feature candidates ---")
for f in feats:
    a=df[f].astype(float).values; b=df["srv_"+f].astype(float).values
    md=np.abs(a-b).mean()
    if md>1e-6:
        print(f"feature {f} diverges. sample train vs serve (first 5):")
        for i in range(5):
            print(f"   train={a[i]:.5f} serve={b[i]:.5f} ratio={b[i]/a[i] if a[i]!=0 else float(\"nan\"):.5f} log_ratio={np.log(b[i])/np.log(a[i]) if a[i]>0 and a[i]!=1 else float(\"nan\"):.4f}")
' 2>&1 | tail -40

cd "$PWD" && venv/bin/python -c '
import hopsworks, numpy as np
proj = hopsworks.login()
fs = proj.get_feature_store()
train_fg = fs.get_feature_group("skew_training", version=1)
serve_fg = fs.get_feature_group("skew_serving", version=1)
q = train_fg.select_all().join(serve_fg.select_all(), on=["entity_id"], prefix="srv_")
df = q.read()
df = df.dropna(subset=["srv_f1"]).sort_values("entity_id").reset_index(drop=True)
print("matched rows:", len(df))
feats=["f1","f2","f3","f4","f5"]
for f in feats:
    a=df[f].astype(float).values; b=df["srv_"+f].astype(float).values
    diff=np.abs(a-b)
    print(f, "max_abs_diff", round(float(diff.max()),6), "mean_abs_diff", round(float(diff.mean()),6), "corr", round(float(np.corrcoef(a,b)[0,1]),6))
print("--- details for diverging features ---")
for f in feats:
    a=df[f].astype(float).values; b=df["srv_"+f].astype(float).values
    if np.abs(a-b).mean() > 1e-6:
        print("FEATURE", f)
        for i in range(6):
            ta=a[i]; sb=b[i]
            ratio = sb/ta if ta != 0 else float("nan")
            print("  train", round(float(ta),5), "serve", round(float(sb),5), "serve/train", round(float(ratio),5), "serve-train", round(float(sb-ta),5))
' 2>&1 | tail -40
